changes.why: v0.12.0 removed R.I, the identity alias deprecated in v0.11.0
v0.12.0 removed R.appendTo, deprecated in v0.11.0
v0.12.0 removed R.prependTo, deprecated in v0.11.0
v0.12.0 removed R.get, the prop alias deprecated in v0.11.0
v0.12.0 removed R.propOf, deprecated in v0.11.0
v0.12.0's and(a, b) is the value operator a && b; the predicate combinator it was moved to both: the signature changed from (T -> bool, T -> bool) -> (T -> bool) to (bool, bool) -> bool
v0.12.0's or(a, b) is the value operator a || b; the predicate combinator moved to either: signature changed
v0.12.0's not(a) is the value operator !a; the predicate combinator moved to complement: signature changed

v0.12.0's substring is slice (String.prototype.slice instead of substring): a negative index counts from the end and the indices are not swapped (substring(3, 1, 'abcde') went from 'bc' to '', substring(-2, 5, 'abcde') from 'abcde' to 'de')
knock-on of substring (v0.12.0 substring(__, Infinity)): a negative n counts from the end (substringFrom(-2, 'Ramda') went from 'Ramda' to 'da')
knock-on of substring (v0.12.0 substring(0)): a negative n counts from the end (substringTo(-2, 'Ramda') went from '' to 'Ram')
new in v0.12.0: the predicate combinator f(...) && g(...) that and was until v0.11.0
new in v0.12.0: the predicate combinator f(...) || g(...) that or was until v0.11.0
new in v0.12.0: the predicate combinator !f(...) that not was until v0.11.0
new in v0.12.0 (@category List): aperture(n, list), the windows of n consecutive elements
new in v0.12.0 (@category List): none(fn, list), the complement of any
new in v0.12.0 (@category String): str.charAt(n), a negative n counting from the end
new in v0.12.0 (@category String): str.charCodeAt(n), a negative n counting from the end; NaN out of range, so the index must fall in the string
